steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Watch out.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Phew... Thanks. There's so many reports in this pile, I just can't stack them right.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Huh? Mudrock? You're back!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How long has it been since you left on your field mission? A month?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yup, the mission dragged on for a while, but I can finally get some rest now.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Dr. Folinic, um, if you don't mind me saying... you don't look very well.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Really? Maybe I've had a little too much coffee the last couple days.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Are you sure you're not pushing yourself too hard?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Not at all. Things have been a little busier than usual, though.

spans.text: been a little busier than usual, though.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We are putting together a team to deploy to Ursus. Everyone on the ship is as busy as could be.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh, I guess it's not a landship anymore... I mean the HQ, but I guess you know that, right?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yeah. Ursus?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We'll get a proper announcement soon. I guess I can just tell you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Amiya and the Doctor are planning to lead an elite team to Ursus.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No wonder everyone seemed so busy when I got back...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: In that case, I'll—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Wait, Mudrock.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Um... Are you free right now?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I need a hand. I want to throw a party in the canteen.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: A party?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Yes, I want to invite a couple friends who'll be going to Ursus.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What does that have to do with me?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I told you, I need a helping hand.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Dr. Folinic... I'm sure I don't need to remind you how we got off to a rocky start...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Are you sure I'm the right one? Do you really want me to help you with your party?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You remember what happened in Wolumonde, don't you?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I remember. I remember it all. I wanted to medicate myself, at the time...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You really don't know how to sugarcoat things, do you?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Nothing's changed. Even though you didn't hurt anybody, if your Originium Arts ever go berserk and put Rhodes Island in harm's way, know that I will take any necessary measures against you, without hesitation.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I believe you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So I ask again... Why me?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's because we don't know each other that well, or rather... because we once stood against one another... that I think this is our best chance to get to clear the air.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What are we looking for?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A box. It should have my name on it... Come to think of it, this is really strange.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We've been working for the same company for years now.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're the one who convinced me to stay...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I hesitated before, too. I asked myself if I could really live under the same roof with you people.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And before I knew it, time flew so fast.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Have you found the answer, then?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Not yet, but at the very least, I didn't really think about it at all, when I invited you to join us.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Found it. Right here.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Give it, I'll carry that.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Some things I brought to Rhodes Island with me when I joined. I took them to a branch office they sent me to. Thinking back, that might've been some kind of omen.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I never told you how I ended up at Rhodes Island, did I?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I think you did. You mentioned Dr. Kal'tsit sent somebody to Ursus to bring you here.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right, Rhodes Island had just been formed, and it wasn't until some time after, when the Chernobog operation took place.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'd heard that Dr. Kal'tsit was coming to get me. I thought I knew where we were going, so I grabbed all kinds of things that turned out to be pretty useless. Like this—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Is this... an Ursine portable Originium stove?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Could you take it apart for me? I want to see if the spray head inside can still be used.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: This model is pretty old.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Rhodes Island's standard-issue Originium electric heating module is only one-third its size, but it's twice as effective.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I want to make a soup with this.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Why do you insist on using it?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Have you ever been to the Ursine tundra?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I've heard stories of the place. It's a land of death where even Originium Arts are frozen.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's right. In the extreme cold, those precise machines become unreliable.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: When the temperature drops below minus fifty, when the Originium storms kill all electrical circuits...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Your life depends on these ugly, cumbersome things that burn liquefied Originium.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: When I was a kid, I couldn't stand the stench. The fumes always made me tear up.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But now... they put my mind at ease.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Because as long as the fire is still lit, it means I haven't been devoured by the snowy white hell.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You seem pretty particular when it comes to the stove. There's probably more to this whole thing than just cooking soup?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I need to make sure it will light up in one go, no hiccups.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Sure, it's still full of energy.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Just like Mother used to be, all those years ago.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Too bad, I'm not nearly as brave as she was.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: At the very least... you had the courage to stand against the rioters of Wolumonde.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That wasn't courage. That was recklessness. Dr. Kal'tsit said that only those who survive can speak of courage.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You know what, Mudrock? Rhodes Island's heaters might be efficient, but there's always something missing, when you cook with them.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The slightly smokey flavor, with the broth brought to a boil in the raging flames, bringing out the meat's aroma...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's the taste of home.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The place where Amiya's team is going, that's real, true cold.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I want them enjoy hot soup, cooked on a stove like this, while they're camping out in the wilderness.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even when they're out in a snowstorm, I want them to know that... their home is right there with them.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The taste of home...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: (You want everyone on the team to have hot soup while they're out in the wilderness?)

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: (No, you need to ensure that it'll function, even in unsurvivable environments.)

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: (Are you doing this for them, or are you doing this for yourself?)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Okay. We tested the fire. It's working perfectly.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Come. Onto our next stop.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Aside from food, we need to prepare a little surprise for our guests tonight.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Your room is a lot messier than I imagined.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Can't be helped. I just don't have the energy to clean up.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I can help you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Forget it. Every time I put in the effort, I end up not being able to find my things.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: These clay dolls... are cleaning up for me?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I don't like untidy spaces.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: *sigh...*

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm just thinking that you and I really don't get along.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Still though, thanks.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Let me know if you need housekeeping in the future.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Forget it. Let's have your clay dolls help me pack.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Pack what? Are these... gift boxes?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Something like that. I'm planning on holding a raffle at the party.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Wait. A raffle?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Yes. It's a party after all. You need something for the attendees to look forward to.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And everyone invited to the party is on the team getting deployed. Amiya, the Doctor, and a few other operators.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm hoping to give them some gifts that'll actually be useful during their trip, but if I gave them to them outright...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You know how Amiya is. She'd say, 'You should keep it and use it yourself, Folinic.' The Doctor would definitely say 'We should prioritize distributing resources to those who need them'.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So you're using the raffle as an excuse to give them these things?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right. If they're just prizes they win in a game of chance, they probably won't say no.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Mudrock, could you get me the boxes with the ribbons on the table there? Right, those ones.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: A lot of craftsmanship went into the boxes' decoration.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What do you think of this? How's the ribbon?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It's beautiful, but what's inside? It seems pretty heavy.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Look inside. That's tonight's top prize.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Is this... a notebook?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: 'Research Notes on Originium Arts and Herbalism'... and 'First Aid Manual in the Ursine Extreme Cold'?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Did you write these yourself?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Yes, they are the sum total of everything I learned from Dr. Kal'tsit over the last few years, my own research on the special cases in Wolumonde...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...and... what I built on top of my mother's research.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: To a doctor, this is the most precious thing in all the lands.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: These notes are like a weapon and life itself. And you want to... turn them into a giveaway prize?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But if you give them away, what about you?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You still need to work on your research and treat patients. Without these notes, your work will be a lot harder.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's okay.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I probably... won't have any need for them for a long while.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I don't have the energy to work on research this intricate anymore.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: They'll be putting them to far greater use in Ursus than I ever could by keeping them here for myself.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What do you mean, you have no need for them anymore?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I mean, I work on other things now.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Look at everything scattered all over the room. These past few days, I've been thinking... the living actually don't need so many things.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Like these books, this equipment, and this old coat that I've so gotten used to wearing...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If I can't take them along, keeping them here would just be more things to worry about.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: In that case, I might as well give them people who actually need them. That way, even if I'm not around, these things can still be put to good use.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Nothing, never mind. Let's start packing.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: That's the last of it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Thanks for the help, Mudrock.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Are we all done, then? In that case, I'll—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Just a moment.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: There's one more favor I want to ask of you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Could you... help me deliver an invitation?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: An invitation? To who?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: To you, and all your companions who came with you to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So you asked me to help because you were planning to invite us all along?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Well...?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We've gone on plenty of missions together over the past few years.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I had nothing against you, even back in Wolumonde.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But at the time, they were your enemy.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Even now at Rhodes Island, they've been instinctively avoiding you, worried about confrontation.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I know. Of course I can tell.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: My memories of my time there... are filled with fire and fury. There was a time when I even wanted to purge this place of every last one of them.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But that's also why I want them at the party.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Because there's something I'll announce that has to do with them, too.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Mudrock, there are way too unknowns in this operation. There's no telling when everyone will be back.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I want to have a chat with them before they leave.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I don't want to... have any regrets about this.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No regrets, huh...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: There are things that I may never get the chance to tell them, if I don't do it now.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If we've reached the point where we can set aside our differences, then I hope we can face this together candidly.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Here's a bottle of Leithanian wine. I've treasured it for a long time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I was saving it for Dr. Kal'tsit's return... We would've enjoyed it together... to celebrate her homecoming.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But now, I think there's a much better place for it to go.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Tell them, I hope they will come to tonight's party. I have some very good wine for them.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Dr. Folinic...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You even brought out your most prized possession.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Because it's worth it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Okay, now go talk to them. I need to head to the cafeteria for the final preparations.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I have to personally watch the fire as the soup cooks.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You light the fire so they can find that last bit of hope to survive in the extreme cold.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You aren't doing this to make soup. You're trying to survive the Ursine tundra yourself. You want to carry that heavy stove to go on the run like your mother once did.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're raffling those notes off to say goodbye to your past.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're giving up your identity as a doctor and giving away your life's work. You're even worried they might not accept your work if you hand it to them directly, so you're turning it into a raffle.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: And this bottle of wine... and an invitation to your old enemies...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're doing this to shrug off the hatred and regrets that have been plaguing your mind.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Dr. Folinic, I think I have a good idea of what kind of announcement you're going to make...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If that's the path you've chosen, then I should probably do something for you too.
The room's light has been tuned to a warm orange glow, and its walls are adorned with simple ribbon decorations.
There is steam floating out of a few large pots. The aroma of borscht wafts through the whole space.
The operators are gathered in small groups, and although each of them looks visibly exhausted, the hot food is proving to be an excellent source of comfort.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thanks, Folinic... This soup is really good. It warms me up.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's great to hear, Amiya. Have some more.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Winters in Ursus last a long while. Remember this taste, okay? This is the flavor of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Dr. Folinic...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh? Mudrock, you're here.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Your friends are here too, and look how happy they all seem. Thank you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What's wrong? You seem a little hesitant. Do you want some, too? I left you a bit of extra meat. It's right in the pot, kept warm on the stove.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Well, now that you're here, I guess it's time to make my announcement.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Allow me.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I know what it is you want to tell everyone.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You've got arrangements for everything and everyone, except yourself.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You brought out a stove that can be used in the extreme cold, without any care for efficiency, to reminisce about your mother.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're raffling off your notes, to sever your ties.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You invited your old enemies here, giving them even your precious wine, to leave no regrets.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're making arrangements.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I know you want to go to Ursus. You want to get revenge. You want to trade your life for Dr. Kal'tsit's.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I can see that none of the preparations you're making point to survival. This is all about destruction.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You don't want to be a burden to anyone, so you're giving away everything you have.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But I can't accept that.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Since you've already decided, I won't stop you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But those things are too heavy. You can't carry them all by yourself.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll watch those things you can't take.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll watch over our Rhodes Island for you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Now go. Do what it is that you want to do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um... Mudrock? Are you sure you aren't misunderstanding something?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Stop! Time out!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Sorry, everyone. Everything's fine. This is just... a little miscommunication between me and Mudrock.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Mudrock, step outside with me. Immediately. Right now.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Phew... Shouldn't be anyone here. Mudrock, seriously... you're way overthinking this!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Are all Sarkaz so imaginative?!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Overthinking? Everything you've prepared... and what you said...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Listen to me, Mudrock. Take a deep breath and let me explain.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: First, the stove is for Amiya's team!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: They'll be camping outside, and Rhodes Island's electric heaters aren't reliable in the extreme cold. I don't want them to freeze to death before they even make it to Ursus!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I dug it out so Amiya can enjoy some hot soup at night, so they can feel the warmth of home!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Wait... It's for Amiya? You aren't going to carry that there with you?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Why would I even do that? I wouldn't be able to run with that thing!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Second, the notes that I'm giving out...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's because Dr. Warfarin just gave me a promotion!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'll be dealing with administrative reports forever, plus a whole shipload of medical personnel. I won't have time for any research!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's why I wanted to take this chance to organize everything I've learned and hand it over to the team that's leaving for Ursus.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Third, I didn't invite your friends because I wanted to bury the hatchet or anything like that!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You didn't?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Of course not!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm staying here to hold the fort! You know how much of the base's defense force has been assigned away.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Amiya's leaving, along with a few elite operators, and Dr. Kal'tsit's not here.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Rhodes Island will be very vulnerable.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You and your team will be a vital defensive asset.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'll be fighting alongside all of you to protect this place we call home.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If I keep putting on airs and giving them the cold shoulder, how are we supposed to band together when the enemy comes attacking?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Are you not going?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Amiya and the Doctor are going. You're Dr. Kal'tsit's protege. You have more reason than any of them to go.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You hate Ursus so much, and you miss your mother so deeply...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Actually, Amiya asked me if I wanted to come.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: She offered to let me join the team when they were putting the roster together.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Then you...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I turned her down.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Why did you turn her down?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm aware of my weakness.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: My Arts and combat skills are of very limited use on a battlefield of that level.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If I'd accepted, I'd only be a burden to the rest of the team. I don't want them to have to protect me, even while everyone's focused on their mission.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Folinic... you're selling yourself short.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No, I'm speaking objectively.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I despise Ursus. That's not going to change. Ever.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I used to think that, by making my way back and killing all my enemies there, I'd get my revenge, but Dr. Kal'tsit taught me that vengeance isn't the only fuel that drives our two feet.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The longer I've lived at Rhodes Island, the more I've felt just how much blood and sweat Dr. Kal'tsit poured into this place.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's my wish that, by the time she comes back, the Rhodes Island she sees won't be any different from the one she left.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: When the time comes, I'll proudly walk over to her, and tell her that I played a part in keeping this place the same as it ever was.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And you will have played a part, too.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Alright, so, I guess we've cleared up that misunderstanding, then?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: They're waiting for us in the canteen.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If you'll stay here and be Rhodes Island's anchor...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Then I'll stay, too.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll be a shield. Leave our security to me.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll make sure my guys fall in line. They'll be the firmest line of defense.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Pff...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm counting on you, then. It's reassuring to have you around.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Okay, let's head back. The borscht is getting cold.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yeah.
